title: fix(cicd): the slow-test report reads a fully skipped shard as schema drift
description:
## .what
`cicd-common/best-practice/.github/workflows/report-slow-tests.sh` exits 1 as schema drift on a shard whose every test skipped. zero durations is the drift signal, and a fully skipped shard also has zero durations, so the report cannot tell the two apart. in rhachet-roles-bhrain the claude-sonnet shard skips all 72 of its tests and the check went red.

## .the fix this repo carries
count test files where any test passed or failed; zero means the shard ran no test, so report it and exit 0. the schema alarm still guards a shard that ran:

```sh
ran=$(jq '[.testResults[] | select(any(.assertionResults[]?; .status == "passed" or .status == "failed"))] | length' "$results")
if [[ "$ran" -eq 0 ]]; then echo "slow-test report: $total test files in $results, every test skipped" >> "$summary"; exit 0; fi
```

## .ask
adopt the branch in the practice file, with a clamp case for a fully skipped shard. at origin/main the file holds no `skip` branch today.

first seen in rhachet-roles-bhrain `.route/v2026_11_19.declapract.upgrade`, stone 3.1 (D11), classified a practice bug in stone 3.2.
